featureNameVi: 認証 & 権限管理 (Authentication & Authorization)
scope: Phase 1 MVP — F8-01 認証 + F8-02 権限管理 only (F8-03 audit + F8-04 backup ở branches sau)

architecturePattern.rationale: Phase 1 scale 50 concurrent users không cần microservice; team 7 người không đủ ops; module boundary đủ cho future split khi cần

components.name: auth module
components.responsibility: Authentication + authorization (login/logout/refresh, 2FA, password mgmt, role guards, invitation accept)

components.name: users module (within auth or separate)
components.responsibility: User management (list, role assignment, status changes, profile updates, admin actions)

components.name: notification module (minimal stub)
components.responsibility: Send transactional emails (invitation, password reset, security alerts) qua SMTP

components.name: audit module (stub)
components.responsibility: Write audit events to audit_logs table (full implementation in F8-03 branch)

components.name: bootstrap CLI
components.responsibility: One-time admin creation on fresh deployment

components.name: shared/crypto
components.responsibility: Argon2id wrap, AES-256-GCM helpers, token generators

components.name: shared/database
components.responsibility: Prisma client singleton, base repository pattern

components.name: shared/observability
components.responsibility: Pino logger với redaction, traceId injection

patterns.name: Token rotation with family lineage
patterns.reference: Auth0 best practices, OWASP Session Management

infra.cache: Redis 7 (ElastiCache, used cho rate limit + future BullMQ)

entitiesExtended: User (add 2FA fields, role enum, status enum, lockout fields)

serverSide.sessionStorage: JWT in HttpOnly cookies (stateless access) + refresh token state in DB
serverSide.rateLimitState: Redis (per-IP, per-user, per-IP+email combo for login)
serverSide.configState: AWS Secrets Manager (prod) loaded at app startup

nfrAddressed.approach: Argon2 tuned to ~150ms; rest = DB lookup + sign
AES-256-GCM cho 2FA secret; RDS at-rest encryption
Stub service writes synchronously to audit_logs
PII encrypted at rest; Pino redaction for logs; audit trail
Unit (services/guards) + Integration (controllers with test DB) + E2E (supertest)

inScope: F8-01 認証 (login, 2FA, refresh, logout, password mgmt, invitation accept)
F8-02 権限管理 (role-based + per-resource framework, user mgmt admin)

risks.description: Argon2 tuning chưa hợp với prod hardware → login latency vượt 500ms
risks.mitigation: Benchmark on production-like instance before deploy; adjust params

risks.description: 2FA secret encryption key compromise → all 2FA secrets exposed
risks.mitigation: Key trong Secrets Manager với rotation policy; consider AWS KMS upgrade Phase 2

risks.description: Refresh token race condition (concurrent refresh from multiple tabs)
risks.mitigation: DB transaction với row lock on refresh token record

risks.description: Audit log synchronous write có thể slow down auth operations
risks.mitigation: Phase 1 scale OK; migrate to async queue trong F8-03 branch

risks.description: Invitation token rò rỉ qua email forwarding
risks.mitigation: Single-use + 24h expiry + audit log accept event
